required_changes: For direct official HMLR GML, require CRS equivalent to EPSG:27700 before exact matching.
For converted intermediates, require official GML source SHA and explicit conversion receipt.
Record transformer definition, expected accuracy and area of use for every permitted conversion.
Disallow ballpark transformations and require best-available operation semantics.
Persist pre-transform and normalized EPSG:27700 geometry hashes.
Record transform-applied flag and displacement/bounds audit.
Fail closed before exact-match promotion if source CRS or conversion provenance is unproven.
